name: Button/Main
description:
**Overview:** The primary call-to-action (CTA) button.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use for the main action on a page (Submit, Save, Create).
- ❌ DO NOT use multiple main buttons next to each other.

**Props / Variants:** Size, Level, State, Leading/Trailing Icon.

**Original Notes:** Interactive elements that trigger actions, forms, or navigation.

name: Button/Flat
description:
**Overview:** A ghost/text button with no background, representing the lowest visual priority.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use for secondary or supportive actions (Cancel, Learn More).
- ❌ DO NOT use for primary form submissions.

**Props / Variants:** Size, Level, State, Text, Icon.

**Original Notes:** Interactive elements that trigger actions, forms, or navigation.

name: Button/Overlay
description:
**Overview:** A labeled button with an overlay fill, designed to stay legible over images, dark surfaces, or media backgrounds.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use over hero images, video backgrounds, or photo-fill cards.
- ✅ Use inside dark-themed banners or panels where a standard button blends in.
- ❌ DO NOT use on plain white or light-grey page backgrounds — use Button/Main or Button/Flat instead.

**Props / Variants:** Size, Level, State, Text, Leading/Trailing Icon.

**Original Notes:** Interactive elements that trigger actions, forms, or navigation.
